Statements.leftDiagonal_not_both_eventually_white : ∀ (k : ℕ),
  ¬((∃ N, ∀ j ≥ N, leftDiagonal k j = false) ∧ ∃ M, ∀ j ≥ M, leftDiagonal (k + 1) j = false)

Statements.leftDiagonal_period_le_of_white_count : ∀ (m q N n : ℕ),
  0 < q →
    ∀ (w : ℕ → ℕ),
      w 0 = 0 →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), w i ≤ w (i + 1)) →
          (∀ i < n, (∀ (J : ℕ), ∃ j ≥ J, leftDiagonal (m + 1 + i) j = true) ∨ w i < w (i + 1)) →
            PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal m) q N →
              PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal (m + 1)) q N →
                ∃ M,
                  PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal (m + n)) (2 ^ w n * q) M ∧
                    PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal (m + n + 1)) (2 ^ w n * q) M

Statements.leftDiagonal_step_of_white_parity : ∀ (m q N : ℕ),
  0 < q →
    PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal m) q N →
      (∀ j ≥ N + 1, leftDiagonal (m + 1) j = false) →
        (Even (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, if leftDiagonal m (N + j + 2) = true then 1 else 0) →
            PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal (m + 2)) q N) ∧
          (Odd (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, if leftDiagonal m (N + j + 2) = true then 1 else 0) →
            ∀ n ≥ N, leftDiagonal (m + 2) (n + q) = !leftDiagonal (m + 2) n)
